_note: Legendary Blessings (Beta 0.7, workstream 5). Hand-written from docs/plans/instrumentality/notes-pack/LEGENDARY_BLESSINGS.md. In-run only: no cross-run memory. status: supported = the whole effect works; limited = part of the effect works (see limits); disabled = not in the pool until its mechanic exists.

blessings.name: The Guardian of Life
blessings.objectText: a pink shell, dusted with glittering scales
blessings.passage: It scatters healing as a child scatters petals, and with as much thought for where it lands.
blessings.headline: THE PETALS FALL WHERE THEY WILL
blessings.summary: After every battle, your most hurt Pokémon recovers 10% HP.
blessings.limits: Communion and its Rite are not built.

blessings.name: The Fair Wish
blessings.objectText: a purple chain worn as a necklace
blessings.passage: It wished to be lovely, and was made lovely, and has not looked at anything else since.
blessings.headline: THE WORLD IS KINDER TO THE LOVELY
blessings.limits: The extra charming event answer is not built. Communion and its Rite are not built.

blessings.name: The Rainbow
blessings.objectText: a golden feather falling through darkness
blessings.passage: Three perished in the burning tower, and it wept, and they rose and ran. Therefore look up, you who have lost.
blessings.headline: SACRED ASH
blessings.summary: Once per region, after a battle, every fainted Pokémon in your party is restored.
blessings.limits: Communion and its Rite are not built.

blessings.name: The Time Keeper
blessings.objectText: an ancient hourglass, turning by itself
blessings.passage: And from the beginning, time was set into motion. Yet even the river of eternity may be made to flow backward, for the Keeper remembers what has passed.
blessings.headline: TIME BENDS TO YOUR WILL
blessings.summary: The next five turns need not be your last.

blessings.name: The Space Traveller
blessings.objectText: a pearl with a fold in it that the eye cannot follow
blessings.passage: It set the near beside the far and called it a road. Ask, and the mountain shall stand behind you that stood before.
blessings.headline: REARRANGE THE ROAD
blessings.summary: Once per region, swap any two nodes of a stage before entering it.
